title: AtlasRuntimeRecord
description: Runtime compatibility is always bound to a runtime, version, and backend. A bare 'compatible = true' is forbidden, and a .gguf extension alone proves nothing about stock llama.cpp, LM Studio, Ollama, Jan, CUDA, or Metal support. Specification version 0.1.0.

runtime.description: Runtime project name, e.g. llama.cpp. Never inferred from the file extension.

runtime_version.description: Exact version or commit; some architectures or quants need a recent build or a custom fork.

backend.description: e.g. CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, CPU. Support on one backend never implies support on another.

support_source.description: Where the support statement comes from (official docs, test log, issue link). Mandatory for official/verified status.

fork_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the custom fork.

known_limitations.description: e.g. architectures needing a fork, quants unsupported on a backend.
